articles.summary: Mortgage-free homes across seven states are creating opportunities that will last for generations. For the veterans and families who receive a Built to Honor® home, the greatest impact begins after the ribbon is cut, when homeownership creates stability, opportunity and peace of mind for years to come. Built to Honor Groundbreaking in Orlando, Florida That's exactly how U.S. Navy Petty Officer Robert Orr, who received a Built to Honor home in 2024, describes the experience: "This home has been far more than a place to live. It has been the foundation that has allowed our family to grow, heal and build a future." Built to Honor provides mortgage-free homes to injured veterans and their families. Last year, the program surpassed its 100th mortgage-free home delivery , marking a major milestone in its 15-year history. In 2026, nine PulteGroup divisions are leading 10 home projects for veterans across seven states, all united by a single purpose: helping veterans build stronger futures
articles.title: PulteGroup's Built to Honor Program Helps 10 Veteran Families Build Stronger Futures in 2026
